Title:

Critical FBT bug: lower-leg / foot input detected during calibration but not applied after calibration

Description:

I previously submitted a report for this issue, but I can no longer find it. The issue is still reproducible on the current VRChat build, so I am submitting it again with clearer details.

This appears to be a critical full-body tracking issue.

The important point is that VRChat clearly detects my lower-body tracking input during calibration. The foot / lower-leg calibration spheres correctly follow my actual leg movement. This means the trackers are not simply missing or undetected.

However, after calibration is completed, the avatar’s lower legs and feet do not correctly follow that same movement. The input is visible during calibration, but it is not correctly applied to the avatar afterward.

Setup:

- Tracker: Opsens+ in IMU mode

- VRChat: default public Steam build, not open beta

- Issue started after the 2026-04-14 JST update

- The same setup worked normally before that update

- Multiple avatars tested

- Issue occurs across avatars

Observed behavior:

1. Start full-body calibration.

2. Foot / lower-leg calibration spheres correctly follow my movement.

3. Complete calibration.

4. After calibration, the avatar’s lower legs / feet do not correctly follow.

Expected behavior:

If the calibration spheres correctly follow foot / lower-leg movement during calibration, the same input should be applied to the avatar after calibration.

Actual behavior:

VRChat detects the lower-body input during calibration, but the avatar’s lower legs / feet stop following correctly after calibration.

Troubleshooting attempted:

- Checked height settings

- Hip Lock enabled

- Locomotion Animations disabled

- Tested legacy calibration

- Checked OVR Advanced Settings / offset settings

- Tested multiple avatars

- Opsens+ appears to function normally

Impact:

This makes full-body tracking effectively unusable, even though VRChat visibly receives the lower-body input during calibration.

Request:

If an immediate fix is not possible, I would appreciate any workaround or guidance. Is there any setting, calibration option, or temporary workaround I should try? Even without an estimated fix date, any advice to make FBT usable again would be very helpful.

If this issue cannot be fixed immediately, I would at least appreciate any workaround, temporary solution, or recommended settings.

At the moment, full-body tracking is effectively unusable for me because VRChat detects the lower-body input during calibration, but the avatar’s lower legs / feet do not follow correctly after calibration.

Even if there is no estimated fix date, any guidance would be very helpful.

For example:

- Is there any setting I should change?

- Is there any calibration option that may avoid this issue?

- Is there any temporary workaround for affected users?

- Is there anything I can test on my side to help identify the cause?

I do not necessarily need an immediate fix. I would just like to know if there is any way to make full-body tracking usable again for now.

details:
Platform:

PCVR (Steam, stable branch)

Affected setup:

Opsens+ IMU full-body tracking

Issue summary:

After the update released on April 14, 2026 (JST), all avatars suddenly stopped moving correctly below the knees.

The lower legs and feet no longer follow properly after calibration.

What is happening:

During full-body calibration in VRChat, the calibration spheres respond correctly to my foot / lower-leg movement.

This suggests that the tracking data is reaching VRChat during calibration.

However, after calibration is completed, the avatar’s lower legs / feet stop following properly in actual movement.

Important details:

- This happens on all avatars, not just one avatar.

- The problem started suddenly after the April 14, 2026 JST update.

- It was working normally until late at night / early morning before that.

- I did not intentionally change my VRChat settings before this started happening.

- My height is set correctly.

- Hip Lock was already enabled.

- Locomotion animations were already disabled.

- Legacy calibration also did not fix the issue.

- This does not appear to be an avatar-specific issue.

What I already tested:

- Tried multiple avatars

- Restarted VRChat

- Restarted SteamVR

- Tried legacy calibration

- Rechecked height settings

- Rechecked my tracking setup

- Recalibrated my Opsens+ IMU setup

- Reset related tracking-side settings

Tracking side status:

My Opsens+ IMU setup appears to be working correctly.

I already confirmed this multiple times.

The tracking data is visibly reaching VRChat during calibration, because the calibration spheres respond correctly.

The problem seems to happen after that stage, when the avatar should actually apply lower-leg / foot movement.

Additional note:

I cannot currently provide output logs or a video recording.

I only speak Japanese, so it may take me some time to read and reply in English. Thank you for your patience.
title: Lower legs and feet stop following on all avatars even though tracker movement is detected during FBT calibration
